compatible_bindings.contract: C Runtime state and pointer relay remain separate; no overwrite; state snapshots preserved.
UI truth bridge must register after report watcher and prioritize RESULT_COMMENT over RESULT_KEY.
ActualRepeatReleaseAdapter requires runtime.tick, runtime.complete and popupBridge.send.
Candidate bridge records repeat receipt after release and accepts C/Repeat results in distinct namespaces.
Launcher switch is prohibited unless smokeReceipt.status is PASS.
Any copy, smoke or launcher failure must branch to rollback.

implementation_actions.interface: Installer preflight must assert all three exact files and preserve W3 load order TRUTH_BRIDGE -> CSS after base CSS -> UI after base JS.
implementation_actions.test: Positive: exact three files PASS. Negative: remove each file independently and expect distinct nonzero exit.

implementation_actions.observed: Installer checks only actual_candidate_bridge_binding.cjs for Repeat.
implementation_actions.canonical: Also require repeat_command_runtime.cjs, actual_repeat_release_adapter.cjs and c_repeat_namespace_adapter.cjs.
implementation_actions.interface: Construct RepeatCommandRuntime -> ActualRepeatReleaseAdapter -> CRepeatNamespaceAdapter -> ActualCandidateBridgeBinding in that order.
implementation_actions.test: Negative fixture for each missing dependency; positive load and snapshot without C/Repeat cross-cancel.

implementation_actions.observed: BackgroundBrowserDispatch stores completed IDs in memory; WorkControlEventLog is separate; smoke logs only SMOKE_START.
implementation_actions.canonical: Wire dispatch start/attempt/pass/fail/close and duplicate suppression events to append-only work-control JSONL; persist dispatch snapshot/receipt before browser release.
implementation_actions.interface: BackgroundBrowserDispatch accepts optional eventLog and receiptStore adapters; restore completed IDs on restart.
implementation_actions.test: Restart after PASS suppresses duplicate; failed attempts logged; close count exactly one per opened handle; JSONL verify PASS.
